DELEGATE ADMISSION & DISPATCH

YOUR SEAT IS CONFIRMED, ALEX MORGAN

Two days on the Lisbon waterfront with two thousand builders, forty speakers, and everything we know about building software that endures.

Registration Order #NWS-2027-004218 · Professional Delegate Tier

The Foundry was built to pour iron into anchors. Next March, we take over its vaulted stone halls to examine what makes digital systems weather their own storms: how high-performing teams keep shipping small, why resilient design outlasts hype cycles, and what happens when software is authored for the next ten years instead of the next release sprint.

Your registration for the Professional pass has been recorded in full. Below you will find your official pass credentials, your block assignment, and your fast-track details.

“We do not build software for the moment of its launch. We build it for the quiet years that follow.”

Maya Okonkwo, Opening Keynote · Lisbon 2027
